title: Immutable native buffer capsules
objective: Add a runtime-owned immutable UInt64 capsule with WeakMap storage, exact binding, copied fallback access, and zero-copy authorized native leases

oracles: cross-owner, binding, forgery, mutation, and GC regressions
exceptions: Host WeakMap state is the representation primitive that makes an owned typed span opaque and read-only to mathematical Python while allowing a synchronous native borrow

handoff.summary: Added a generic immutable UInt64 capsule whose owned BigUint64Array and exact owner/model/format/count binding live in private WeakMaps. Frozen empty capsule and lease objects expose no indexed storage; authenticated generated wrappers receive a read-only zero-copy native borrow while source-transparent dynamic execution requires an explicit owned copy. Focused tests cover CPython/dynamic/native agreement, zero callbacks, storage opacity, cross-owner and binding rejection, forgery, write rejection, and garbage collection.
risks: Cross-platform native borrow behavior remains for integration CI on Linux arm64, Windows x64, and macOS arm64.

The full compiler fixture command was attempted but four unrelated algebra fixtures could not load the absent optional packages/flint/build/Release/sagejs_flint.node; all eleven fixtures not requiring that addon passed.
next_steps: Integration must register test/immutable-uint64-capsule.cjs in the shared Node test manifest.

Hyperelliptic consumers can replace Python tuple packing with one capsule per exact owner/model/format/count binding, request a lease only for native read-only calls, and request a copy for dynamic fallback.
Run the focused test on the required non-x64 platforms and rerun the complete compiler suite in a checkout with the optional FLINT addon prepared.
